text: Noor is flying to Lahore sometime next week for her cousin's wedding. She said the flight is eleven hours with a change in Doha. Remind me to text her the day before she leaves.
Called Jorge. He and Camila have a second flat viewing in Leith on Saturday morning, and they're putting in an offer the next day if it's as good as the photos.

Liam's mum is having her knee operation at the end of the month. He's driving up to Leeds the day before and staying for a week after to look after her, because his brother can't get time off work. He sounded really worn out on the phone, and he admitted he hasn't been sleeping much. I should ring him the evening after the operation to see how she is.
Femi got the flat on Cranbrook Road! Moving in early November. Must send congrats.

spans.text: got the flat on Cranbrook Road

text: Lunch with Nadia. Her brother Karan has just moved to Toronto for a job at a bank, and their parents are visiting him over Christmas. She is pretending she's fine about it but she misses him a lot.
Saanvi hates long flights. She's off to Sydney in early March and already dreading the twenty-two hours. Don't forget to send her that list of podcasts before she goes.

spans.text: send her that list of podcasts

text: Bruno and his wife have called off the Portugal trip. Her dad isn't well, so they're staying home and going up to see him instead.
Henrik's moving to Copenhagen over the summer. He starts at the new office the week after he lands.
Camila mentioned she would love a decent travel pillow. Birthday is mid-January, so worth remembering.

text: Hiroshi and Fang got back from Kyoto yesterday. Ask Hiroshi how the ryokan was and whether Fang's mum enjoyed meeting the family.

spans.text: Ask Hiroshi how the ryokan was and whether Fang's mum enjoyed meeting the family

text: Aoife has a viewing for a two-bed in Rathmines on Thursday. If she gets it she'll move at the end of the month, and her sister Lila is taking her old room.

text: Need to book my own flights to Lisbon before the prices go up. Sometime this week ideally.

text: Yaw is a huge Arsenal fan and goes to every home game with his uncle.

Spoke to Tomás on the phone. His grandmother died on Monday and the funeral is in Seville on Friday. He's flying out the day before. I should message him that morning, just to say I'm thinking of him.
Marcus and Shanice are expecting! Due early April. They told us at dinner and then spent the rest of the evening arguing about names.
Fang said the move to Manchester went smoothly, but the new flat is freezing and the landlord still hasn't fixed the boiler.

Mihai's sister Elena is coming over from Bucharest for two weeks at the end of the month. It is her first time in the UK, and he has planned far too much. He wants to take her to the Lake District the weekend after she arrives, then London for a couple of days, then a night in York before she flies home. She loves hiking, so the Lakes will be the highlight. Remind me to ask Mihai if they want to borrow the tent.

spans.text: take her to the Lake District
ask Mihai if they want to borrow the tent

text: Khadija passed her driving test this morning, third time lucky. She's planning a road trip to Cornwall over half term with her cousins.
Lena is nervous about the flight to Seoul next Tuesday. First time flying alone, and she has a tight connection in Frankfurt. Text her good luck the night before.
Esther's new place has a garden, so she's finally getting a dog. She's picking up the puppy, Biscuit, sometime next week.
Malik told me his dad is retiring at the end of the year and his parents are moving back to Accra afterwards. Malik isn't sure how he feels about it.

spans.text: isn't sure how he feels about it

text: Theo has a second interview with a firm in Edinburgh on the 14th. If it goes well he and Jaya will relocate in the spring. He seemed calm, Jaya less so.

spans.text: second interview with a firm in Edinburgh

text: Aneesh is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Good to know for the barbecue.
Groceries, post office, and renew my passport before the trip. Probably Saturday.

Karan said his flat viewing in Bristol was a disaster. The bedroom was smaller than the bathroom. He has two more lined up for early next week, and I need to call him afterwards to hear how they went.

Lila and Hemi are going travelling around South America for six months. They leave in early February, Lima first, then Cusco a week after, and they're hoping to do the Inca Trail if permits haven't sold out. After that it is Bolivia and then down to Patagonia sometime in April. Their mum is already panicking and has bought them each a money belt. Lila is the organised one; Hemi has not even renewed his passport yet.
Hemi's grandad turns ninety next Sunday. The whole family is flying to Auckland for it, and Hemi is giving a speech at the party that evening.
Coffee with Sam. He's thinking about moving to Berlin sometime next year but hasn't decided. His girlfriend Jaya works remotely, so she could go anywhere.
Lwazi is moving into his new flat in Cape Town at the end of the month. He wants help painting the weekend after. Remind me to ask Lwazi which weekend suits.

spans.text: moving into his new flat in Cape Town

text: Jorge's sister had her baby on Tuesday, a little girl called Rosa. He's flying out to Mexico City to meet her sometime next month. I should get a small gift for him to take.

spans.text: get a small gift for him to take

text: Noor and her husband are doing up the house before they sell it. They want it on the market by early spring, and they'll rent somewhere nearby afterwards.
Liam's cat Pickles went missing the day before he moved. Turned up two days later at the old flat, sitting on the doorstep like nothing happened.
Femi is struggling a bit since moving to Glasgow. Doesn't know anyone yet and the job is full on. Must call him this weekend.
Nadia is off to Marrakech with her mum and her aunt at the end of the month. Her aunt has never been on a plane before, so Nadia is a bit worried about the flight.
Saanvi's housewarming has been cancelled. The movers lost half her boxes and she's still sleeping on a mattress on the floor.

Bruno said Henrik has been offered the Singapore job. It's a big promotion, head of the regional team, and he would start in early January. He has to decide by Friday, and his partner Marcus is not keen on moving that far, mostly because his parents are getting older and he doesn't want to be a thirteen-hour flight away. Bruno thinks Henrik will take it anyway. Don't forget to ask Henrik on Monday what he decided.

spans.text: not keen on moving that far
ask Henrik on Monday what he decided

text: Quick note: Camila and Tomás are hosting Thanksgiving this year, even though neither of them is American. Camila is doing the turkey, Tomás the pies.
Hiroshi's parents land at Heathrow on the 3rd. He's picking them up that morning and they're staying with him until mid-December. Remind me to ask Hiroshi how the first week went.

spans.text: ask Hiroshi how the first week went

text: Aoife's in the middle of a messy move. Her landlord is selling, she has to be out by early next month, and she has nowhere lined up yet. I should check in on her on Wednesday.
Yaw and his brother are doing a cycling trip across the Netherlands over the summer. Amsterdam to Maastricht in a week.
Booked the dentist for sometime next week. Need to confirm the time.

Marcus told me all about his trip to Iceland with his wife and the boys. They hired a camper van and drove the ring road over nine days. They saw the northern lights on the second night, and the day after, his son got food poisoning from a petrol station hot dog and spent the morning being sick behind a waterfall. Still the highlight of the year, apparently. He wants to go back in winter.
Mihai is allergic to nuts. Remember for the Christmas dinner.

Khadija and her sister Esther are viewing a house together in Sheffield this weekend. It is a three-bed terrace near the park, and if they like it they want to put in an offer the next day before anyone else does. Their mum is lending them the deposit, which she keeps reminding them about. Khadija sounded excited; Esther is much more cautious and worried about what happens if one of them wants to move out later. Remind me to text Khadija on Sunday to see how it went.

spans.text: viewing a house together in Sheffield

text: Elena has her citizenship interview in early December and she's really anxious about it. The ceremony would be a few weeks after if it goes well. Text her good luck that morning.
Lena and Shanice are going to Japan in April for the cherry blossom. Lena wants to go back to Tokyo afterwards for a few days on her own. Shanice hasn't said yes yet.
Shanice mentioned she has been eyeing a good suitcase for ages. Her old one fell apart in Rome. Could be a nice leaving present before she moves to Dublin.
Spoke to Esther Kaur after the meeting. She moved to Birmingham in the summer and loves it. Her husband is still commuting to London twice a week, which is wearing him down.

spans.text: commuting to London twice a week

text: Malik's flight to Lagos got cancelled last night, so he's now going on Thursday instead. His mum's sixtieth is on Saturday, so it's tight but fine.
Theo's moving to Bristol at the end of the month and his leaving drinks are on the Friday before. Must remember to sign his card.
Aneesh and his wife have just got back from their honeymoon in Bali. I should ask him for the photos and the name of that villa.

spans.text: ask him for the photos and the name of that villa

text: Karan's daughter starts at a new school in Leeds after half term, since they've just moved up. She's nervous about not knowing anyone. Karan says she'll be fine.

Jaya's sister Lila is getting married in Goa early next year. Jaya is maid of honour and has to organise the hen do sometime in the autumn, for fourteen women across three countries who all want different things. On top of that she is flying out a week before the wedding to help their mum with the mehndi, and her boss has only just approved the leave. She is quietly losing her mind but says it is fine.
Caught up with Hemi at the gym. He's training for the Berlin marathon, which is at the end of September. Ask him how his knee is holding up.

spans.text: Ask him how his knee is holding up

text: Sam said his dad, Uncle Ray, is finally selling the farm. They're moving into a bungalow in Devon sometime over the summer.

spans.text: moving into a bungalow in Devon

text: Lwazi went to the viewing on Tuesday and loved it. He put in an offer that evening and heard back the next morning. Accepted! Send him a congratulations message.

Dinner with Jorge Lopez, Noor and Liam. Jorge is moving to Madrid in early spring for work, and he has somehow sorted out his whole life over one plate of pasta. Noor is buying his car, Liam is taking over the lease on his flat, and his plants are coming to me. He flies out the week after his leaving party, and his girlfriend Camila follows at the end of March once her notice period is done. Very efficient friendship group.

spans.text: once her notice period is done

text: I'm flying to Montreal on the 9th for Femi's wedding. Staying a week after with Nadia and her family. Need to buy a suit before then.
Saanvi's grandparents celebrated their fiftieth anniversary at the weekend. She flew to Mumbai for it and came back the next day, completely exhausted.

Henrik's mum, Mrs Nakamura, is visiting from Osaka over the holidays. It is her first trip abroad since his dad died, so he wants it to be special. He is taking her to Edinburgh for a few days after Christmas, and then they will see the New Year in with his partner's family in Manchester. She doesn't eat pork, which he is worried about for the dinner. Remind me to send Henrik the hotel recommendation.
